title: Email extraction - two legitimate addresses, purpose-specific (hard)
prompt: The invoice was sent from billing@example.com, but if you have questions about the charge, please reach out to accounts-receivable@example.com instead. Which email address should be used for questions about the charge?

metadata.hard_reason: Two equally legitimate-looking addresses; the correct answer is the one explicitly tied to 'questions about the charge', not the sender address.
